method: Individually generated poses, whole-image uniform scaling and nearest-neighbor assembly. Right is exact frame mirror.

records.prompt: Draw ONE animation frame of this exact stag, walking slowly LEFT in same three-quarter side camera. Preserve deer face, antler topology, fur colors, head/torso size, leg lengths and pixel-art shading. Exactly FOUR naturally connected legs: two forelegs below chest LEFT, two hindlegs below rump RIGHT. Foreground/near legs overlap and are lighter; far legs slightly darker and visibly behind. True four-beat grounded walk, NOT trot, hop, run or biped. Phase 1 of8: NEAR FORELEG extended forward LEFT, hoof planted in initial contact; FAR FORELEG extended backward RIGHT, heel raised on toe-off; NEAR HINDLEG planted nearly vertical under its shoulder/hip; FAR HINDLEG bent passing under body, hoof CLEARLY AIRBORNE. These are four separate named limbs; do not repeat idle stance. Knees/hocks bend naturally; shoulders/hips remain fixed. Gentle body weight shift, almost stable head and antlers, relaxed ears/tail. Full body and all antlers/hooves visible, same apparent body scale and canvas framing as reference, transparent background, no shadow or text. Crisp stepped pixel art, no smoothing or motion blur.
